author: Polar_Express
body:
First, 

Thanks for Reading! For the Walls Contest I would Like to Submit an Arena Emerald Map for Walls. You start, Mine Emeralds and trade them with Vendors to get the best armor, potions, and weapons you can afford.

There are two armor sets a Cheaper Iron set and a more expensive Diamond set to allow the player to mix and match as they please. 

There are two main weapons a 9.0 damage diamond shovel, abd a 5.5 damage wooden fire sword to keep the damage in check for all players.

The weapons and armor ( even the iron ) are better than the what the enchanter kit or guardian kit can produce so players will depend on the map to prepare for battle. 

YML and Map Download: https://www.dropbox.com/s/x1n57m5xexxhscu/grotto.zip?dl=0  ( updated 1/30/2015 )
Pics : http://imgur.com/a/qIyRs

Features: Shops:
  •  -Iron Armor: Has Iron Armor for trade - The armor adds more hearts to your base health, to keep you in the action, along with enchants
  • -Diamond Armor: Has Diamond Armor for trade - The armor adds more hearts to your base health, to keep you in the action, along with enchants 
  • -Weapon: Has Ranged and Melee weapons for trade -
  •  -Potion and Misc: Has unique to the Map potions that last over 30 min along with Lava buckets, Milk, etc to choose from for play style
  • -Food and Misc: has different types of Food and other supplies
  • -Murph's Flower Shop : Unique Items and potions , only trades in flowers - to add more fun.
  • -Hermit Shop: Trades for special Items
Testing and Balance - Multiple players have played and balanced the map before the submission, so fairness and fun have been taken into consideration with every item and block placed.
Ive seen players make a base on the bridge leading up to the quads, or take over the Keep and defend it. High Skybases are not available in this map but you can still build tree height.

 The map has been designed to offer arena style game play, so feel free to charge into battle as you should be well equipped for a unique walls event.
 
I hope you like it. Thanks for considering it.
